description_en: Queries the deletion status of a member account
description_zh: 调用GetAccountDeletionStatus查询成员删除状态
name: GetAccountDeletionStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account
parameters.name: account_id

RdAccountDeletionStatus.description_en: The deletion status of the member account

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the member account

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the deletion started, in RFC 3339 format with a UTC offset of +08:00
CreateTime.description_zh: 删除开始时间，采用 RFC 3339 时间格式，包含 +08:00 的 UTC 偏移

DeletionTime.description_en: The time when the deletion ended, in RFC 3339 format with a UTC offset of +08:00
DeletionTime.description_zh: 删除结束时间，采用 RFC 3339 时间格式，包含 +08:00 的 UTC 偏移

DeletionType.description_en:
The deletion type. Valid values:

0: direct deletion. If the member account has no pay-as-you-go resources in the last 30 days, the system directly deletes the member account.
1: cool-down period deletion. If the member account has pay-as-you-go resources in the last 30 days, the member account enters a cool-down period. The system starts to delete the member account after the cool-down period ends. For more information about the cool-down period, see [What is the cool-down period for member account deletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446079.html）
DeletionType.description_zh:
删除类型。取值：

0：直接删除。如果成员最近30天内不存在后付费资源，则系统会直接删除该成员。
1：静默期删除。如果成员最近30天内存在后付费资源，则会进入静默期。等待静默期结束后，系统才会开始删除该成员。关于静默期的更多信息，请参见[什么是成员删除的静默期]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446079.html）

FailReasonList.description_en: The reasons for the deletion failure

items.description_en: The reasons for the deletion failure

Description.description_en: The description of the check item
Description.example: This account has a payer account. Please release the financial relationship of this account first.

Name.description_en: The service name of the cloud service to which the check item belongs
Name.description_zh: 检查项所属的云服务名称

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

Success: The member account is deleted.
Checking: The check is in progress.
Deleting: The deletion is in progress.
CheckFailed: The check failed.
DeleteFailed: The deletion failed
Status.description_zh:
状态。取值：

Success：删除成功。
Checking：检查中。
Deleting：删除中。
CheckFailed：检查失败。
DeleteFailed：删除失败
